verses.69:19: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقۡرَءُواْ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ

meaning: The primary meaning of هاء (hA2) is to be easy, light, or contemptible. It also conveys the idea of being vile, ignominious, or despicable.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
